title: The First 30 Days: a starter kit for new family caregivers
description: A 14-page printable kit for the month after you realize a parent needs your help. 30-day roadmap, emergency fridge sheet, medication list and log, appointment tracker, questions for the doctor, documents checklist, home safety walkthrough, and a weekly check-in for you. Instant PDF download, US Letter.

title: 30-day roadmap for new caregivers of aging parents (printable)
description: Four weeks, one focus each, as a checklist. Fill in the fridge sheet, build the medication list, find the documents, book the appointments, walk the house for safety, and put one thing on the calendar for you. Part of The First 30 Days caregiver kit, a 14-page printable PDF.
alt: A 30-day plan for caring for an aging parent

title: Emergency information sheet for an aging parent (printable)
description: If something happens, the person who walks in first should not have to guess. Name, conditions, allergies, current medications, advance directive, doctor, pharmacy, hospital, insurance, and who to call. Print it, tape it up, keep a photo on your phone. From The First 30 Days caregiver kit.
alt: The one sheet to put on your parent’s fridge

title: Printable medication list for caregivers: every provider will ask for it
description: Medication and strength, dose, when taken, prescriber, what it’s for, refill date, allergies, and stopped medications. Fill it in with the bottles in front of you and reprint when anything changes. Part of The First 30 Days caregiver kit (14-page PDF).

title: 13 questions to ask your aging parent’s doctor (printable worksheet)
description: What is the diagnosis in plain words? What should we watch for? Which medications shouldn’t be taken together? Who do we call after hours? Is it still safe to drive or live alone? Check the ones that apply, add your own, write the answers during the visit. From The First 30 Days caregiver kit.
alt: 13 questions to ask your parent’s doctor

title: Important documents checklist for caring for an aging parent
description: You are not creating these documents this month. You are finding out which ones exist and where they live. 18 documents with exists / where it’s kept / who has copies columns. Part of The First 30 Days caregiver kit, a 14-page printable PDF.
alt: 18 documents to find before you need them

title: Home safety walkthrough checklist for aging parents (printable)
description: Rugs, night lights, grab bars, water heater temperature, stove knobs, pill storage, handrails, a neighbor with a key. 30 room-by-room checks and a fix-it table with who does it and by when. From The First 30 Days caregiver kit.
alt: 30 home safety checks for an aging parent

title: Weekly caregiver check-in: the five-minute page that is about you
description: Caregivers who burn out usually saw it coming weeks before they felt it. Sleep, your own appointments, what went well, what was hardest, one task to hand off, one thing for you, and the warning signs worth taking seriously. Part of The First 30 Days caregiver kit (printable PDF).
alt: Caregiver burnout shows up on paper first

title: Weekly medication log for caregivers (printable, initial-the-box)
description: Morning, midday, evening, bedtime, as-needed, seven days across. One sheet a week, five copies covers a month. Space for missed doses, side effects, and refills ordered. From The First 30 Days caregiver kit, a 14-page printable PDF.
alt: The medication log that makes a missed dose obvious
